My last phone was a xiaomi. Bought it because they did an 'SE' version, smaller edition, and I did not want a massive phone. It was half the price of an equivalent Samsung or Apple. Had it for a good few years but now have a Motorola Edge 50 pro....again, an amazing phone for very little money compared to the usual big brand names.
Nobody else I know had a xiaomi, nobody else I know has a Motorola.....I think people are really missing out by always going for Samsung or Apple.
I really fancy the new Moto Signature later this year, but I have to say I'm tempted to go back to xiaomi.
When the xiaomi YU7 car is available here in the UK, I'll swap my Jaguar i-pace for one, and at that point will def go back to a xiaomi phone for full integration.
